final: WITH g AS (SELECT m.Name AS name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), o AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS overall FROM g), k AS (SELECT g.avg_ratio, g.cnt, g.cnt - o.overall AS diff FROM g JOIN o ON 1 = 1 WHERE g.cnt > o.overall) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_size_to_length_ratio, SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(diff) AS avg_difference FROM k
